name: Old television / CRT treatment
summary: Verified base flicker and colour treatment evoking a CRT display; no overlay construction is claimed.
creativeJobs: place a moment in the past
suggest a mediated or recorded image
add texture to a clean source
qualityChecks: flicker reads as a display artefact rather than a render error
failureModes: flicker fast enough to raise a photosensitivity concern
an overlay offset measured against the timeline instead of the parent clip, which silently misplaces it
safety: check against the three-flashes-per-second threshold before shipping any flicker

riskGates.basis: Admitted base emitter is exactly full→0.82→full at frames 0, duration/8, and duration/4; with the 4s default it completes one dip/recovery by 1s, so no one-second interval contains more than one flash event.

safetyGates.basis: Bounded only to the admitted single-dip base construction with floor 0.82. Any repeated or stronger flicker is refused until remeasured against the W3C three-flashes-per-second criterion.

provenance.claim: Final Cut supports blend modes on connected clips
a connected clip is a child of the spine asset-clip with lane=1 and a parent-relative offset; blend mode is written as an index-and-name string
content should not flash more than three times per second

validation.notes: Generalized emitter admitted 2026-08-07 for the verified base flicker and Color Adjustments construction. No overlay is part of this card; overlay lane, parent-relative offset, and blend mode remain unadmitted.
verifiedOn: clip-a.mov colour bars, base treatment without an overlay

refusalConditions: Do not apply when the stated prerequisite is not met.
